# Koodh

Koodh is a two-person IT team — Chiel van Gansewinkel and Yannick Gijbels. They design and build websites and web apps, set up and manage Microsoft 365 cloud workplaces, design Xink e-mail signatures, install and monitor Wi-Fi and office networks, and provide ongoing IT management and on-site support.

## What Koodh does

- Website development: websites and web apps, designed and built from scratch, with hosting, domains, SSL, updates and backups
- Microsoft 365: mail and file migrations, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, users, licences and devices
- Xink e-mail signatures: one professional house-style signature rolled out to every mailbox
- Wi-Fi & networks: site visits, Ubiquiti UniFi and TP-Link Omada, separate staff and guest networks, monitoring
- IT management: accounts, licences, domains, DNS and hosting in one overview
- On-site support: remote help first, visits when needed, PC and laptop repair, printers

## Own platforms

- Clara: news, radio schedule and ZeroTier network monitoring from one dashboard (https://clr.koodh.com)
- Clara Frames: livestream graphics such as lower thirds, placards and a news ticker
- Clara Campaigns: newsletters and marketing mails in one place

## Pages

- / — homepage with services, the Clara platforms, the team and contact details
- /nieuws/ — news and project updates
- /nieuws/<slug> — individual news articles
